description: Original request (translated from German): 'I am looking for a chart of the advertising revenue of the NZZ since 2000' and 'the whole thing also with data of other newspapers as zukunft.com json'. Advertising revenue of the NZZ media group (2000-2016, with the regional media consolidated) and of the company NZZ (2020-2024, after the regional media moved to CH Media), its total operating income for the advertising share, and for comparison the net advertising revenue of the Swiss press (Stiftung Werbestatistik Schweiz), of German daily newspapers (ZAW, BDZV) and the advertising revenue of US newspapers (Pew Research Center). Values without a quality word are reported figures; 'calculated' marks a number derived from a reported percentage or difference; 'adjusted' marks a comparison figure the company restated for the consolidation change of 2018; 'superseded' marks a first-reported figure later restated; 'assumed' marks a judgement from the dialogue with its confidence. Data version 0.0.2 adds the figures of the NZZ annual reports 2017, 2019, 2020, 2021 and 2022 (revenue by type, print/digital split 2020-2022, total operating income and EBIT 2013-2022) and replaces the back-calculated 2020 and 2021 advertising figures by the reported ones. Four definition breaks of the NZZ series: 2004 full consolidation of LZ Medien, 2012 print and digital reported together, 2018 deconsolidation of the regional media, 2023 partnerships included in the advertising market.

words.name: NZZ
words.description: Swiss German-language daily newspaper published in Zurich since 1780; here also the name of its publishing company AG für die Neue Zürcher Zeitung.

words.name: CH Media
words.description: Swiss media company founded on 1 October 2018 as a joint venture of AZ Medien and the regional media of the NZZ media group.

words.name: advertising
words.description: the practice and techniques employed to bring attention to a product or service.

words.name: revenue
words.description: the total amount of income generated by the sale of goods and services related to the primary operations of a business.

words.name: net
words.description: after deduction of discounts and agency commissions; the net advertising statistics of Switzerland and Germany report what the media actually receive.

words.name: partnership
words.description: revenue from event partnerships and sponsoring, which the NZZ reports inside its advertising market revenue since 2023.

words.name: insert
words.description: advertising supplement inserted into a newspaper; the German BDZV counts insert revenue together with advertisement revenue.

words.name: newspaper
words.description: a periodical publication containing written information about current events.

words.name: press
words.description: here: all printed newspapers and magazines as one media category of the advertising statistics.

words.name: perimeter
words.description: the set of companies included in a consolidated financial statement.

words.name: EBIT
words.description: earnings before interest and taxes; a measure of a firm's profit that includes all incomes and expenses except interest and income tax expenses.

words.name: adjusted
words.description: comparison figure restated by the company for a change of the consolidation perimeter, so that two years can be compared; not the figure of the audited income statement.

triples.name: advertising revenue
triples.description: revenue a medium earns from selling advertising space or time.

triples.name: net advertising revenue
triples.description: advertising revenue after discounts and agency commissions, as surveyed by Stiftung Werbestatistik Schweiz and the German ZAW.

triples.name: print advertising revenue
triples.description: advertising revenue of printed titles; for the NZZ media group 2000-2011 the reported 'Anzeigenumsatz', with electronic media reported separately.

triples.name: advertising and partnership revenue
triples.description: NZZ advertising market revenue as reported since 2023: print and digital advertising plus partnership revenue.

triples.name: advertising and insert revenue
triples.description: German newspaper 'Anzeigen- und Beilagenumsätze' as reported by the publishers association BDZV.

triples.name: user market
triples.description: NZZ term since 2017 for all revenue paid by users: reader market (subscriptions and single copies) plus events, travel and information services.

triples.name: total operating income
triples.description: 'betrieblicher Gesamtertrag', the total revenue of a group before expenses.

triples.name: NZZ media group
triples.description: the consolidated NZZ media group as reported 2000-2017: the NZZ titles plus the regional media (LZ Medien, St. Galler Tagblatt, until 2003 Der Bund); LZ Medien fully consolidated since 2004.

triples.name: NZZ core
triples.description: the company NZZ as reported since 2019, after its regional media were transferred to CH Media on 1 October 2018; CH Media is an equity participation and no longer consolidated.

triples.name: advertising share
triples.description: advertising revenue divided by total operating income.

triples.name: perimeter effect
triples.description: the part of a change in a reported figure that is caused by a change of the consolidation perimeter and not by the market.
